Why go: the shortest sail to the southern islands

Thong Krut is the closest pier to Koh Tan and Koh Madsum, so the half day on Dragon King gives a full four and a half hours on and around the islands for the price of many speedboat charters. The motor dinghy takes you ashore at Pig Island while the catamaran stays at anchor.

It is also one of the few boats on Samui that sells real overnights: a night anchored off Koh Phangan, or two nights in Ang Thong Marine Park after the day boats have left.

Overnight charters

The 1-night charter sails to Koh Phangan waters and anchors overnight, returning the next afternoon. The 2-night charter goes to Ang Thong Marine Park from 16 December and anchors at two different spots, so you see the islands at sunrise and sunset without day-trip crowds. Up to 10 guests sleep in the two cabins and on deck or in the lounge, and there is one bathroom. Order full board or bring food for the BBQ, and pay Ang Thong park fees in cash on arrival.

Who it suits

  • Groups of up to 10 on a sensible budget.
  • Families who want a slow, stable boat to the southern islands.
  • Adventurous groups who want to sleep on board.

Who should choose something else

  • Guests who need hotel-style comfort overnight: one bathroom and deck beds.
  • Guests in Chaweng or Bophut: the drive to Thong Krut is 45–60 minutes; consider a north-coast boat such as the Gavina.
  • Anyone wanting a shared day: see our Pig Island longtail tour.

Good to know

  • Bring food: nothing to eat is included unless you order it.
  • The pigs: let them approach you and don't feed them junk food.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
